The Virtual Block 7.1 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Combat Response (V) (Virtual Block 7)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Combat Response (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010): “Deploy on table. Tallon Roll is canceled. Once per turn, may reveal an unpiloted starfighter from hand to ▲ its matching pilot character (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. Your unique (•) TIEs (except Scythe Squadron TIEs) at systems may use 1 Force to relocate (as a regular move) to system within 3 parsecs. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 23). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Combat Response (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “to a system within 3 parsecs” for “to system within 3 parsecs” (it writes ▲ out as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck … ; reshuffle” and the Immune to Alter icon as “(Immune to Alter.)”, which is notation only): “Deploy on table. Tallon Roll is canceled. Once per turn, may reveal an unpiloted starfighter from hand to take its matching pilot character into hand from Reserve Deck (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously; reshuffle. Your unique (•) TIEs (except Scythe Squadron TIEs) at systems may use 1 Force to relocate (as a regular move) to a system within 3 parsecs. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1271_9-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
